name: Zechariah (Jehoshaphat's prince)
title: Prince sent out to teach the law
summary: Zechariah was one of the princes King Jehoshaphat sent out to the cities of Judah to teach the people the Lord's law, along with Levites and priests.

keyEvents.title: Teacher of the law
keyEvents.description: Jehoshaphat sent Zechariah and other princes throughout Judah to teach the people from the Book of the Law of the Lord.
